name: Verónica Perrotta
biography: Verónica Noel Perrotta González (Montevideo, January 29, 1976) is a Uruguayan actress, director, playwright, and screenwriter. She studied Dramaturgy in Argentina. She starred in the films The Wait (2002) and Mean and Lean Cows (2012). In 2016 she directed her first feature film, Las toninas van al Este.
